description: This file defines a class for configuring and transforming search requests and responses for the Firecrawl search API, including request formatting, environment validation, and response parsing into a unified search result format.

classes.name: FirecrawlSearchConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Firecrawl search API, including environment validation, URL construction, request transformation, and response parsing.

methods.name: ui_friendly_name
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for the search configuration.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates API environment variables and sets authorization headers.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for the search endpoint.

methods.name: transform_search_request
methods.description: Transforms a search query and parameters into the Firecrawl API request format.

methods.name: transform_search_response
methods.description: Transforms the raw API response into a standardized SearchResponse object.
